test_suites.name: test_phase10_health.py
test_suites.description: Comprehensive tests for health check functionality

tests.name: test_health_checker_initializes_with_defaults
tests.description: HealthChecker should initialize with default values
tests.result: HealthChecker initialized with all None dependencies and DEVELOPMENT profile

tests.name: test_health_checker_initializes_with_custom_profile
tests.description: HealthChecker should accept custom profile
tests.result: HealthChecker initialized with PRODUCTION profile

tests.name: test_liveness_returns_true_when_alive
tests.description: Liveness check should return True when process is alive
tests.result: check_liveness() returned True

tests.name: test_database_check_with_valid_connection
tests.description: Database check should pass with valid connection
tests.result: Database check returned UP status with verified connection

tests.name: test_database_check_with_failed_connection
tests.description: Database check should fail with connection error
tests.result: Database check returned DOWN status with connection failed message

tests.name: test_schema_migration_check_with_history
tests.description: Schema migration check should return revision from history table
tests.result: Schema check returned UP status with revision 002

tests.name: test_worker_heartbeat_check_available
tests.description: Worker heartbeat check should pass when worker is available
tests.result: Worker check returned UP status with 2 active workers

tests.name: test_worker_heartbeat_check_unavailable_in_production
tests.description: Worker heartbeat check should be DOWN in production when unavailable
tests.result: Worker check returned DOWN status in PRODUCTION profile

tests.name: test_worker_heartbeat_check_unavailable_in_development
tests.description: Worker heartbeat check should be DEGRADED in development when unavailable
tests.result: Worker check returned DEGRADED status in DEVELOPMENT profile

tests.name: test_provider_registry_check_loaded
tests.description: Provider registry check should pass when loaded
tests.result: Provider registry check returned UP status with 2 providers

tests.name: test_tool_registry_check_loaded
tests.description: Tool registry check should pass when loaded
tests.result: Tool registry check returned UP status with 3 tools

tests.name: test_filesystem_check_all_paths_exist
tests.description: Filesystem check should pass when all paths exist
tests.result: Filesystem check returned UP status, all paths exist

tests.name: test_filesystem_check_missing_paths
tests.description: Filesystem check should fail when paths are missing
tests.result: Filesystem check returned DOWN status with missing paths listed

test_classes.name: TestOverallStatusCalculation
test_classes.description: Tests for overall status calculation logic

tests.name: test_production_all_up_returns_up
tests.description: Production profile with all checks UP should return UP
tests.result: Overall status calculated as UP for production with all UP checks

tests.name: test_production_one_required_down_returns_down
tests.description: Production profile with one required check DOWN should return DOWN
tests.result: Overall status calculated as DOWN for production with worker DOWN

tests.name: test_development_worker_down_only_returns_degraded
tests.description: Development profile with only worker DOWN should return DEGRADED
tests.result: Overall status calculated as DEGRADED for development with only worker DOWN

tests.name: test_development_other_down_returns_down
tests.description: Development profile with non-worker DOWN should return DOWN
tests.result: Overall status calculated as DOWN for development with database DOWN

test_classes.name: TestFullReadinessCheck
test_classes.description: Tests for full readiness check with all components

tests.name: test_full_readiness_all_passing
tests.description: Full readiness check should pass with all components healthy
tests.result: Readiness check returned UP status with all 13 checks passing

tests.name: test_full_readiness_production_no_worker_fails
tests.description: Full readiness check in production should fail without worker
tests.result: Readiness check returned DOWN status in production without worker

tests.name: test_readiness_status_to_dict
tests.description: ReadinessStatus should serialize to dict correctly
tests.result: ReadinessStatus serialized to dict with status, profile, and checks

tests.name: test_health_status_enum_values
tests.description: HealthStatus should have correct values
tests.result: All HealthStatus enum values verified (UP, DEGRADED, DOWN, NOT_REQUIRED)

tests.name: test_health_profile_enum_values
tests.description: HealthProfile should have correct values
tests.result: All HealthProfile enum values verified (PRODUCTION, DEVELOPMENT, TEST)

tests.name: test_health_check_result_defaults
tests.description: HealthCheckResult should have correct defaults
tests.result: HealthCheckResult defaults verified (required=True, details=None)

test_classes.name: TestProfileBasedBehavior
test_classes.description: Tests for profile-based health check behavior

tests.name: test_production_fail_closed
tests.description: Production profile should be fail-closed
tests.result: Production profile returned DOWN with database DOWN

tests.name: test_development_worker_not_required_for_up
tests.description: Development profile should allow UP without worker
tests.result: Development profile returned DEGRADED with only worker DOWN

tests.name: test_test_profile_lenient
tests.description: Test profile should be more lenient
tests.result: Test profile returned DEGRADED with 2 failures (within limit)

tests.name: test_liveness_returns_live

tests.result: GET /health/live returned 200 with {"status": "live", "service": "windagent-api"}

tests.name: test_readiness_returns_up_when_healthy
tests.description: GET /health/ready should return 200 with status 'UP' when all checks pass
tests.result: GET /health/ready returned 200 with status UP and all checks

tests.name: test_readiness_returns_503_when_not_ready
tests.description: GET /health/ready should return 503 when checks fail
tests.result: Endpoint properly returns 503 with error details when not ready

tests.name: test_readiness_includes_all_required_checks
tests.description: GET /health/ready should include all required checks
tests.result: Response includes all 13 required checks from PHASE 10

tests.name: test_readiness_in_production_profile
